title: Milestones 8-11: Dependency Graph and Parallelization Guide
summary: Dependency graph, parallel sprint schedule, release sequence, critical path, and risk mitigations for Milestones 8 through 11.
notes: MANIFEST_TYPE=DOC applied as authoritative. Content is a planning/coordination guide: dependency graph, sprint schedules, release gates, critical path, risk table. Key dependency relationships: M8 has no hard dependencies; M9 hard-depends on M8 (must wait for M8 Epic 4 rename); M11 hard-depends on M8 (stable paths) and partially on M9 (Epics 3-4 wait for M9 Epics 1-3 API stability, Epics 1-2 start immediately); M10 has no hard dependency, only a soft dependency on M8 for its Epic 3 (release config waits on M8 crate structure). Critical path M8 -> M9 -> M11 Epics 3-5 = 11-17 sprints; M10 off critical path. Release order v0.2.0 (M8), v0.3.0 (M9), v0.4.0 (M10), v0.5.0 (M11), with noted possibility that v0.4.0 ships before v0.3.0, and an alternative numbering (v0.2.0, v0.2.1, v0.3.0, v0.4.0). cross_refs are milestone/epic names as written; no file paths or markdown links are present in the source.
